name: component-capture-bounds
goal: Component evidence screenshots bound the rendered component itself, excluding preview titles and empty page canvas while preserving required layout and overlay context

evidence: EnvironmentPicker thumbnails currently show the preview page h1 and empty viewport. Capture rendered component bounds, excluding preview-only chrome, with small framing allowance; preserve full visual layouts and active dialogs.

Existing component-catalog-previews matrix checks content, readiness and document fit but never compares saved PNG dimensions with component geometry. Extend that same matrix for compact, inline, display-contents and multi-root previews; retain layout/dialog context coverage.
